full_prompt_en: A square figurative oil painting presents a formally posed young girl with pale blond curls, a dark green dress, and a mustard bow against a cream floral background. The background is warm ivory with faded orange flowers and thin gray-green stems spreading around the edges. Its open central area gives the head a quiet halo of pale color, while the pattern becomes denser toward both sides. The girl's bust fills the lower two thirds of the composition, aligned almost exactly on the center line. A small dark hat sits behind the wave of hair at the upper left, its curved black shape partly hidden by the curls. The blond hair is arranged in short, glossy rolls around her ears and forehead, each curl catching narrow warm highlights. Her light eyes look forward without a strong smile or frown. Soft pink gathers beneath the eyes and across the cheeks, while the nose and lips are modeled with restrained warm shadows. The face has a smooth, nearly porcelain surface, but small changes of flesh color keep it from looking flat. Below the neck, the deep forest green dress has a rounded collar and broad, simple shoulders. A yellow ochre ribbon is tied at the throat, its loops spreading across the center and its tails hanging into the lower edge of the frame. Darker green shadows sink into the folds near the arms, with only small highlights separating them from the central torso. The lighting is soft and frontal, slightly stronger from the upper left, leaving delicate shade beneath the chin and along the right side of the face. Painterly touches remain subtle: hair and floral background carry more visible strokes than the carefully smoothed skin. The close crop excludes the hands and most of the body, concentrating attention on the symmetrical gaze and the contrast of green clothing with cream wallpaper. The overall composition is still and decorative, mixing meticulous facial modeling with gently faded floral color for a poised, slightly uncanny mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形具象油画描绘一名端坐的年幼女孩，浅金色卷发、深绿色连衣裙和芥末黄色领结映在奶油色花纹背景前。背景是暖象牙色，褪淡的橙色花朵与细细的灰绿枝茎沿边缘蔓延。中央较开阔的部分在头部周围形成安静的浅色光晕，花纹在两侧则变得更密。女孩的胸像占据画面下方三分之二，几乎正对中轴。小小的深色帽子藏在左上方的发浪后面，弯曲的黑色形状被卷发部分遮挡。金发在耳旁和额前盘成短而有光泽的卷，每一绺都承接狭窄的暖色亮部。浅色眼睛正视前方，既没有明显微笑，也没有皱眉。眼下和双颊泛起柔和粉色，鼻子和双唇则由克制的暖影塑形。脸部表面平滑，近乎瓷器般细腻，但细微的肉色变化使它并不扁平。颈部以下，深森林绿连衣裙有圆润衣领和宽阔简洁的肩线。一条黄赭色缎带在喉间打结，结环向中央展开，垂下的两端伸向画面底边。手臂附近的褶皱沉入更深的绿色阴影，仅有细小亮部把它们与中央上身分开。光线柔和、从正面照来，左上方略强，使下巴下方和脸部右侧留下轻柔阴影。绘画笔触十分克制：头发和花纹背景比精心磨平的肌肤留有更多可见痕迹。紧密裁切排除了双手和大部分身体，使视线集中于对称的目光以及绿色衣服与奶油色墙纸的对比。整体构图静止而富装饰感，将细致的面部塑形与柔和褪色的花卉色彩结合，形成端庄而略带奇异的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The figurative oil painting combines carefully smoothed tonal modeling with softly visible brushwork in surrounding surfaces. Pale warm areas are built from fine shifts of cream, pink, and muted gold, giving rounded forms a polished, almost porcelain finish. Dark saturated green and ochre accents provide a firm visual anchor against a low-contrast field of faded orange and gray-green ornament. Curved edges are precise around the principal light forms, while secondary patterns loosen into thin stems, washed color, and lightly scumbled texture. Soft frontal illumination spreads evenly across the center and leaves only restrained shadows beneath projecting shapes. The composition is close, centered, and nearly symmetrical, yet small irregularities in line and floral rhythm keep it from becoming mechanical. Background ornament remains legible at the margins and quieter behind the focal area, helping the brightest forms hold attention. The overall effect is poised and faintly uncanny, balancing meticulous surface control with a delicate decorative haze.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅具象油画将仔细磨平的明暗塑形与周围表面柔和可见的笔触结合。浅暖色区域由奶油色、粉色和低饱和金色的细小变化搭建，使圆润形体拥有光洁、近乎瓷器般的表面。深而饱和的绿色与赭黄色重音在褪淡橙色和灰绿装饰构成的低对比色域前建立坚实锚点。主要浅色形体周围的曲线边缘十分精确，次要纹样则松散为细茎、冲淡的颜色和轻微擦涂的肌理。柔和正面光均匀铺在中央，突出的形状下方只留下克制的阴影。构图紧密、居中且近乎对称，但线条与花纹节奏里的细小不规则使它不显机械。背景装饰在边缘保持可辨，在焦点后方变得安静，帮助最亮的形体吸引目光。整体效果端庄而隐约奇异，在精密的表面控制与轻柔的装饰薄雾之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A formally posed young girl with blond curls and a dark green dress
theme_zh: 金色卷发、深绿连衣裙的女孩端坐肖像
name: John Currin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
